content.text: Stale results come from `useSearch`: every keystroke starts a request, and whichever response arrives last wins. I'll cancel the previous request when the query changes.

    5	export function useSearch(query: string) {
    6	  const debounced = useDebounce(query, 250)
    7	  const [results, setResults] = useState<Result[]>([])
    8	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
    9	
   10	  useEffect(() => {
   11	    if (!debounced) return
   12	    setLoading(true)
   13	    fetchResults(debounced)
   14	      .then(setResults)
   15	      .finally(() => setLoading(false))
   16	  }, [debounced])
   17	
   18	  return { results, loading }
   19	}
